values.binNote: Bin's KatarinaR#ADDamageCalc writes the same relationship as ((0.16)*(1 + 3.125x bonus attackWindup))x bonus ad, i.e. base coefficient 0.16 on bonus AD and a scaling term of 3.125 applied directly to the fractional bonus attack speed value (not per-100%). The wiki reformulates this identically as 16% base + 50% per 100% bonus AS (since 0.16*3.125 = 0.5), so the numbers agree once the bin's fractional-vs-percent convention is accounted for; listing bin:[] because the checker cannot directly match 0.16/0.5 against the bin's 0.16/3.125 without this derivation.
Wiki states 0.166s per dagger; bin's TicksPerSecond=6 implies an interval of 0.1667s, a slight rounding difference.

values.meaning: Grievous Wounds duration inflicted on target
values.quote: inflicts {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} on the target for 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: Katarina channels, throwing a dagger every 0.166 seconds to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions; against a single dummy target, all daggers land on it.
mechanics.quote: rapidly throwing a dagger every {{fd|0.166}} seconds to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions

mechanics.claim: Each dagger deals both physical and magic damage and applies on-hit and on-attack effects, with those on-hit/on-attack effects reduced in effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: Each dagger deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced in effectiveness

mechanics.claim: Each dagger counts as a separate hit for on-hit-triggered effects like Conqueror, Electrocute, and Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: Each dagger counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Conqueror}}, {{ri|Electrocute}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}}

mechanics.claim: The on-attack damage-effectiveness reduction incorrectly (bug) also applies to various other damaging effects triggered by the same damage instance, such as Hail of Blades, Scorch, and several items.
mechanics.quote: The on-attack modifier also incorrectly applies to various other damaging effects triggered by the same damage instance, including {{ri|Hail of Blades}}

mechanics.claim: A spell shield will block and be consumed by only one dagger, not the whole channel.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block and be consumed by only one dagger.

mechanics.claim: Death Lotus does not end early if no enemies remain in range.
mechanics.quote: ''Death Lotus'' will not end if no enemies remain in range.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins on cast.
